Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
d-h...@cs.uiuc.edu (David Hyatt) writes:

>Does anyone know exactly what restrictions apply to the BOTB
>tournament at GenCon? I know it's a 40-60 card deck, which
>is unusual. What other restrictions are there? Are Jyhad
>cards allowed in the library?

The "Best of the Best" VtES tournament at GenCon is completely
misnamed:

It follows all DCI rules, but (are you sitting down?) it adds a
FOUR CARD LIMT!

You certainly can't get all of the "best" VtES decks to work in
a 4CL environment.

(The DCI rules include a uniform crypt, BTW. I believe that you
can still mix V:tES vampires with AH vampires, though, even
though the backs are distinguishable at 500 yards :-). All ante
cards are banned, as are cards with "paralyze" effects, as well
as the Monocle of Clarity. And, in addition to the 40-60 maximum
split you note, there is a six-card limit on certain cards (like
KRC, Parity Shift, etc.) - but that becomes moot under the burden
of 4CL)
